card_name: ICICI Bank Rubyx Visa Credit Card
fee_details:
- Joining Fee: Rs. 3000
- Annual Fee: Nil. First year from the second year Rs. 2000 plus service tax has to be paid from joining year onwards and will be processed off the customer's bank account.
joining_perks: - As a welcome gift, customers who avail an ICICI Bank Rubyx Credit Card can also get a complimentary pair of Sennheiser HD215 headphones, after they pay the joining fee. The gift will be delivered within 30 days of the payment.
reward_structure:
- Cardholders can get up to 4x Handpicked reward points for every Rs. 100 spent on specific categories: 
    - Purchases done on shopping and travel and other essentials can get you 2 reward points.
    - Groceries/Supermarkets (Grocery/ Departmental Store)
    - Consumer Durables/Electronics
    - Booking of travel portals, airlines, hotels and car rentals.
key_highlights:
- ICICI Bank Rubyx Visa Credit Card comes with an embedded chip which protects against duplication and counterfeit. An extra level of protection comes from the PIN number which has to be entered for every transaction. Online transactions can be completely secured by Verified by Visa (V BV) services.
 - Cardholders can enjoy a surcharge waiver of 2.28% on transactions done at any petrol bunk in India, for a maximum value of Rs. 4000.

benefits_features.Travel benefits: Booking of travel portals, airlines, hotels and car rentals
benefits_features.Fuel benefits: Cardholders can enjoy a surcharge waiver of 2.28% on transactions done at any petrol bunk in India, for a maximum value of Rs. 4000
benefits_features.Dining benefits: Under this program, ICICI Bank Rubyx Visa Credit Card members can get up to a minimum discount of 35% on dining bills at the partner restaurants.
benefits_features.Lounge benefits: Customers can enjoy complimentary access to premium Visa airport lounges across India using ICICI Bank Ruby Visa Credit Card. Customers can get up to two free visits in a quarter. They also get provided with free Wi-Fi, gourmet meals, media services along with their card. The participating lounges are Plaxx Premium Lounge, Carnation Lounge, Clipper Lounge, Travel Club Plus (TCP) and more premium lounges.
benefits_features.Renewal benefits: Annual Fee: Nil. First year from the second year Rs. 2000 plus service tax has to be paid from joining year onwards and will be processed off the customer's bank account.
benefits_features.Entertainment benefits: ICICI Bank Ruby Visa Credit Card holders can enjoy up to 40% on movie tickets bought on BookMyShow every day of the month. Customers can get up to two movie tickets worth Rs. 250, free for every month. The prices for the tickets can differ on some terms and serve and depend on the availability.
benefits_features.Spa and Wellness: ICICI customers can use their ICICI Bank Rubyx Visa Credit Cards to avail spa and wellness packages across India
benefits_features.Kani: Card holders can get up to 30% off on Ayushya packages and 20% off on fitness evaluation and personal history with Dotha analysis
benefits_features.Golf Privileges: ICICI Bank Ruby Visa Credit Card holders can enjoy one complimentary round of golf if the real and actual purchase transaction on their cards is Rs. 1,00,000 or more for the previous month. This complimentary offer is applicable for a single round only.

how_tos.How to avail joining perks: The gift will be delivered within 30 days of the payment
how_tos.How to redeem reward points: Customers can call on the 24/7 ICICI Bank Customer Care
how_tos.How to pay outstanding:
- Cash Deposit at ICICI Branches
- Internet Banking
- Cheque/DD: These can be deposited at the branch, ATM or at any ICICI drop box.
- Auto Debits
- Click to Pay/NEFT Transactions
how_tos.How to modify reward plan: Customers also have the flexibility to change their rewards plan according to their spend pattern, every month

reward_point_benefits: - Handpicked reward points validity and action on the card and the card account must be active without overdue.

fees_and_charges.Annual Fees: Nil. First Year from the Second Year: Rs.2000
fees_and_charges.Transaction Fee - Cash Advance: 2.5% of the advance amount or minimum of Rs.200
fees_and_charges.Transaction Fee - Overdraft: 3% of the draft amount or a minimum of Rs.300
fees_and_charges.Auto-Debit return/ Return of cheque: 2% of the total amount due or minimum of Rs.250
fees_and_charges.Over Limit Fee: 2.5% of the over limit amount or minimum of Rs.500

miscellaneous: ICICI Bank Rubyx Visa Credit Card is a kind of visa card which comes with outstanding privileges.

faqs.What is the validity period for handpick: Handpicked reward points do not carry any validity period.
faqs.How can ICICI Bank Ruby Visa Credit Card: Customers can call on the 24/7 ICICI Bank Customer Care
